generation.scope: For a pencil containing an invertible prescribed commutator, the four-coefficient linear reconstruction has rank three or four. A singular defect direction is a multiple determinantal root. All invertible defect directions give line components of an explicit conic of the target three-space and admit an exact square-root and affine-line reconstruction using two Sylvester inverses, including nondiagonalizable matrices.

open_mathematics: Prove when rank four can always be obtained by changing the marked direction. Analyze the Jordan product of a pair with invertible commutator, and the exceptional nets in which a repeated determinantal line forces persistent rank three. Then apply this structure to finite-edge regularity.
